title: Install and maintain Platter
summary: Install and maintain Platter under coordinated maintenance. Import schema-one runtime files into SQLite while preserving packet and delivery history.
use_when: The user wants Platter installed, replaced, inspected or maintained.
The caller needs prerequisite readiness, admission holds, draining or supported installed-release verification.
An operator must preserve a separately managed Clockwork daily binding while upgrading its pinned Platter runner.
do_not_use_when: The requested outcome is packet preparation, a test email, job discovery, profile editing or scheduled delivery.
The caller expects arbitrary direct rollback, a schema reset or implicit installation of dependencies.
outcome: An installation with matching Platter command and provider, supported maintenance state, or a local readiness result. Stored domain history remains intact.

interfaces.label: Install the committed candidate under maintenance
Validate supported state and take deployment backup
Print the selected release daily failure policy without activation

effects: Coordinated installation publishes matched runtime/installer/provider bytes through owned selectors. It starts no packet preparation or email.

Durable owner holds fence new mutations while exact admitted work drains. Explicit migration preserves retained identities, creates a current-schema backup, and removes only hashed legacy files after successful import/backup.

Read-only checks inspect installation/state/dependency readiness without domain work. Explicit supplied setup can initialize missing templates or activation intent. Existing schedules are retargeted disabled and captured intent is restored only after holds release.

Installation performs resource setup, configuration, initialization or migration, and publication under the operation's maintenance hold. It does not invoke doctor or gate completion on persistent-state validation or runtime readiness. Ordinary runtime checks and diagnostics remain separate.
authority: Platter owns domain compatibility, admission, drain policy, retained state and success. Nucleus owns execution state and cancellation.
Cell coordinates selected product installation and maintenance; the shared installer owns release metadata, owned selectors, writer locks and file compensation.
Catalog presence, a successful build or stored delivery time grants no installation, send, recurring-delivery or dependency-upgrade authority.
success: Deployment holds and drains affected work, stages files, configures and publishes selected products, releases only its own holds, and restores captured activation intent. It preserves backups, operator pauses, and incident halts.

Use the exact retained owner, compatible candidate, selected backup, and completion evidence for interrupted migration/coordinator recovery. Do not perform direct installer rollback, reset domain state, or release unrelated holds.

Schema-seven state cannot use an older incompatible binary. Recover with a compatible candidate or explicitly selected complete predecessor data/files backup and matching binary; file compensation does not undo migration.
Preserve Clockwork halts and uncertain sends through deployment. Binding continuation does not authorize a preparation retry or ambiguous resend.
privacy: Private state and backup files contain career history, original resume and packet/send metadata. They remain separate from immutable public installation material and source control.

Installation manifests retain executable/provider identity and local paths, never private resume bodies or provider keys. Model and email disclosures belong only to separately authorized runtime operations.
does_not_authorize: Preparing packets, sending email, collecting jobs, consuming Cast API-key budgets or submitting replacement Nucleus work.
Installing or enabling a daily schedule, changing provider credentials/billing or upgrading unselected dependencies.
Resetting sent flags, deleting retained artifacts, changing fixed resume content or bypassing an unresolved maintenance hold.

consumers.statement: The current user and Cell coordinator use the supported inspection, readiness, maintenance, migration, and installation procedures.

preconditions.statement: Use exact committed source, an owned candidate, compatible maintenance interfaces across affected requesters, the sole matching hold, and proved drain. Read platter.maintenance for admission, dependency readiness, candidate maintenance, and state compatibility. Unselected dependencies are not implicitly upgraded.

inputs.statement: Retain exact owner/candidate identity, absolute backup and optional recovery-receipt paths, and explicit supplied template/projects-template/activation setup when intended. Use the fixed Vita selection and complete Bazaar prompt prerequisites defined by required features.

outputs.statement: Inspection/readiness outcomes, coherent matched runtime/installer/provider selectors, and maintained backup/cleanup/recovery evidence. Required features own exact release and state meaning.

identity_and_units.statement: Preserve the run-owned hold and exact committed candidate, backup digest, and recovery evidence. Maintain retained packet/request/edition/send identities under platter.maintenance without treating hold identity as process liveness.

operational_limits.statement: Installation prepares no packets and sends no email. Missing-template initialization and activation require explicit supplied setup; candidate maintenance starts neither migration nor domain work. Exact cancellation excludes unrelated Weaver jobs.
No installation latency, arbitrary incompatible rollback, future support interval or deprecation window is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Keep the existing operation ID/version and coordinator/recovery routes. Required features own supported state migration and binary/data pairing; no file compensation undoes a schema migration or restores older Nucleus credentials.

reliances.statement: Nucleus supplies compatible execution health and cancellation of matching orphaned jobs.
Runtime prerequisite probes rely on supported Cast export and exact job-URL commands, Annals commands and Email attachment support; unselected installations are not upgraded implicitly.

Cell deployment source and cell-install transactions supply exact committed candidate preparation, coordinator sequencing, release metadata and file compensation. Their source operational manual remains the authority; this entry does not claim an independent installed Cell capability contract.
Resume readiness depends on Tectonic, Python 3 with pypdf, and the original template packages/fonts.

The product-owned schema-two definition declares halt-until-approved. Clockwork owns activation, the shared service-health delay before a new durable halt, incident email and exact continuation approval; Platter owns expected readiness outcomes, date selection and preserved preparation/delivery recovery.
Weaver authors private project Markdown through its typed installed CLI client, with caller-supplied identity and exact-request recovery. It owns its Annals reads and Nucleus jobs.
Bazaar supplies immutable text versions. The caller owns selection JSON, rendering, permissions, and execution; a string supplies no additional authority.
